subject.title: feat: add continuous OpenClaw Auto QA skill

question: Should continuous multi-lane Auto QA be a canonical repository-owned maintainer workflow, or should its reusable guidance be distributed outside the core repository as a ClawHub skill?
rationale: The implementation is documentation-only and composes existing capabilities, but repository policy generally routes optional skill bundles outward unless a repository-specific ownership need justifies keeping them local.

options.title: Adopt as repository workflow
options.body: Keep the skill in `.agents/skills` as the canonical internal QA procedure because its authorization, evidence, and maintainer-routing rules are specifically tied to OpenClaw operations.

options.title: Move reusable guidance outward
options.body: Publish the general campaign workflow as a ClawHub skill and leave this repository with concise links to the existing internal QA and maintainer workflows.

recommendation.title: Adopt as repository workflow
recommendation.body: Keep the skill in `.agents/skills` as the canonical internal QA procedure because its authorization, evidence, and maintainer-routing rules are specifically tied to OpenClaw operations.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author is the available repository-admin/openclaw-secops context for the intended governance and distribution decision.
